name: Wolter Grell
source_profile: ● Wolter Grell (NE) is a wealthy landholder who has begun selling supposed deeds to Briarhearth territory to Cadorian settlers. His claims to ownership are dubious, but his growing wealth has attracted a following.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 57 (source excerpt; may be partial)
